title: Tech Note: 4D View Helper (Source Code, Part II)

historical_commentary.text: This is the second-part reference documentation for '4D View Helper,' a routine library built to simplify displaying arrays or records inside a 4D View spreadsheet-style plug-in area. Since 4D View itself was superseded by 4D View Pro (introduced 2018), this helper library and its routines are tied to a discontinued companion product, making the note obsolete as a practical reference, though the underlying idea of helper routines that bridge 4D data structures (arrays/records) to a grid/spreadsheet display area remains conceptually similar to patterns used with 4D View Pro today.
related_updates: 4D View was superseded by 4D View Pro (introduced 2018), which uses a different object model and API
Displaying arrays/records in a spreadsheet-style area today would use 4D View Pro's newer commands rather than this 4D View Helper component
